searchText: Do people care a lot about mnemonic naming schemes? The most descriptive mnemonic for the proposed EIP-3074 would be `CALL_AS`, `CALLAS` or `CALLFROM`, but these would break the `*CALL` naming scheme that exists. Any thoughts on this?
